response.sql: WITH s AS (SELECT P.SEX AS sex, AVG(CAST(L.CPK AS REAL) / NULLIF(L.GPT, 0)) AS a FROM Laboratory L JOIN Patient P ON P.ID = L.ID WHERE L.CPK IS NOT NULL AND L.GPT IS NOT NULL AND L.GPT <> 0 GROUP BY P.SEX), m1 AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS m FROM s), A AS (SELECT s.sex, s.a FROM s, m1 WHERE s.a > m1.m), m2 AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS m FROM A), B AS (SELECT A.sex, A.a FROM A, m2 WHERE A.a > m2.m) SELECT AVG(B.a) AS avg_ratio, AVG(B.a - m1.m) AS avg_above_first_mean, AVG(B.a - m2.m) AS avg_above_second_mean FROM B, m1, m2
